t: The legacy payment module will be deprecated in the next major release. Clients should migrate to the new API before March, after which the old endpoints will no longer be supported.
o: The legacy module was already removed from the platform in the last release.
The old endpoints will stop being supported after March.
Clients are not allowed to use the new API until the deadline in March.
The new API will be deprecated and replaced by the legacy module.
The old endpoints will remain supported for clients who do not migrate.
e: “Deprecated” = descontinuado/obsoleto; “no longer be supported” = deixará de ter suporte.
x: Errada: o texto diz que o módulo será descontinuado na próxima versão, não que já foi removido.
Errada: o texto pede que os clientes migrem antes de março.
Errada: o módulo legado é que será descontinuado.
Errada: os endpoints antigos deixarão de ter suporte.

t: The new version is backward compatible, so existing integrations will keep working without changes.
q: The expression “backward compatible” means that the new version:
o: requires all clients to be rewritten before upgrading.
works with systems built for previous versions.
is faster than the previous one in every scenario.
can only run on the same hardware as older versions.
will be compatible with versions released in the future.
e: Compatível com versões anteriores (retrocompatível).
x: Errada: retrocompatível dispensa reescrever os clientes.
Errada: compatibilidade não tem relação com desempenho.
Errada: não se refere a hardware.
Errada: isso seria compatibilidade futura (forward compatible).

t: The database became a bottleneck during peak hours, increasing response times for all services.
o: a backup copy of the database used during peak hours.
a component that limits the performance of the system.
a security flaw that exposes the whole database to attacks.
a period of low traffic between peak hours.
a type of index that speeds up database queries.
e: Bottleneck = gargalo.
x: Errada: bottleneck não é cópia de segurança.
Errada: não se refere a vulnerabilidade.
Errada: o termo indica gargalo, não período de baixa.
Errada: é o contrário — algo que limita o desempenho.

t: The service is highly available; however, it does not guarantee strong consistency across regions.
q: The word “however” introduces an idea of:
o: addition
contrast
cause
example
conclusion
e: However = no entanto, contudo.

t: Requests will be rejected unless they include a valid access token.
o: are always rejected, even with a valid access token.
are accepted only if they include a valid access token.
are accepted without a token if they come from inside the network.
must not include an access token to be accepted.
are rejected because they include an access token.
e: Unless = a menos que, a não ser que.
x: Errada: unless indica exceção; com token válido, são aceitas.
Errada: o texto não prevê essa exceção.
Errada: é justamente o token válido que permite a aceitação.
Errada: inverte o sentido de unless.

t: Actually, the issue was not in the code but in the server configuration.
o: atualmente
na verdade, na realidade
rapidamente
eventualmente
raramente
e: Falso cognato: “atualmente” em inglês é “currently” ou “nowadays”.

t: The attacker pretended to be a bank employee in order to obtain the customer's password.
o: pretendeu, teve a intenção
fingiu
provou
impediu
ofereceu
e: Pretend = fingir. “Pretender” (ter intenção) em inglês é “intend”.

t: After the failed deployment, the team decided to roll back to the previous version and shut down the faulty service.
q: The phrasal verbs “roll back” and “shut down” mean, respectively:
o: atualizar e iniciar
reverter e desligar
configurar e reiniciar
publicar e monitorar
testar e excluir
e: Outros comuns: set up (configurar), log in (entrar), back up (fazer cópia de segurança).

t: The security team has identified three vulnerabilities since the last audit.
q: The verb tense “has identified” (present perfect) indicates an action that:
o: will happen in the future, after the next security audit.
started in the past and continues to be relevant up to now.
happened at a specific finished moment, with no link to the present.
is happening right now, continuously, at the moment of speaking.
had already finished before another past action.
e: O present perfect é usado com “since” e “for” para períodos que chegam até o presente.
x: Errada: o present perfect não expressa futuro.
Errada: isso é o simple past.
Errada: isso é o present continuous.
Errada: isso é o past perfect.

t: All transactions are logged and monitored by the fraud detection system.
q: In the sentence, the agent of the actions “logged” and “monitored” is:
o: all transactions
the fraud detection system
the customers
the bank employees
not mentioned
e: Na voz passiva, o agente é introduzido por “by”.

t: Containers package an application together with its dependencies, which ensures that it runs the same way in development, testing and production. Unlike virtual machines, containers share the host operating system kernel, making them lightweight and fast to start.
o: include a full operating system kernel each.
share the host kernel and start quickly.
run differently in each environment.
are heavier than virtual machines.
do not include application dependencies.
e: “Unlike virtual machines, containers share the host operating system kernel.”

t: The API gateway validates incoming requests before forwarding them to the backend services. It also enforces rate limits.
q: In the second sentence, the pronoun “It” refers to:
o: the backend services
the API gateway
the incoming requests
the rate limits
the validation
e: “It” retoma o sujeito da frase anterior, “the API gateway”.

t: The outage lasted two hours and affected online banking for thousands of customers.
o: atualização programada do serviço
interrupção do serviço (indisponibilidade)
saída de dados do sistema (output)
migração do serviço para a nuvem
aumento repentino de acessos
e: Outage = queda, indisponibilidade de serviço.
x: Errada: atualização é update ou upgrade.
Errada: falsa semelhança com output; outage é queda do serviço.
Errada: isso seria spike ou surge.

t: Developers should have reviewed the code before merging it into the main branch.
o: an obligation that developers must fulfill in the future
regret or criticism about something that did not happen in the past
a strong possibility that the code is being reviewed now
a permission given to developers to skip the review
an ability that developers had in the past
e: Should have + particípio = deveriam ter feito (mas não fizeram).
x: Errada: should have + particípio refere-se ao passado.
Errada: não expressa possibilidade no presente.
Errada: habilidade no passado seria could.

t: If the primary database fails, traffic will be redirected to the replica automatically.
o: an impossible situation in the past and its imagined result
a real and possible condition with its expected consequence
a wish about the database that cannot come true
a habit that always happened in the past
an order given to the operations team
e: First conditional: if + presente, will + verbo — situação real/possível.
x: Errada: isso é o third conditional.

t: Multi-factor authentication significantly reduces the risk of account takeover. Even if a password is stolen, the attacker would still need access to the user's second factor, such as a mobile device.
q: The main argument of the text is that MFA:
o: eliminates the need for passwords, replacing them with mobile devices.
makes account takeover harder, since a stolen password is not enough.
is useful only for mobile devices, which are the main target of attacks.
increases the risk of account takeover when a password is stolen.
replaces encryption as the main protection for stored passwords.
e: O texto argumenta que, mesmo com a senha roubada, o atacante precisaria do segundo fator.
x: Errada: o texto não diz que dispensa senhas.
Errada: o dispositivo móvel é só um exemplo de segundo fator.
Errada: o texto diz que reduz o risco.
Errada: o texto não fala em criptografia.

t: The new release improved throughput by 30%, allowing the system to process more transactions per second.
o: the number of errors per thousand requests
the amount of work processed per unit of time
the time a single request takes to complete
the number of users registered in the system
the maximum storage capacity of the main database
e: Throughput = vazão, taxa de processamento.
x: Errada: isso é taxa de erros.
Errada: não se refere a armazenamento.

t: The batch job runs at night, whereas the real-time service processes requests continuously during the day.
o: add similar information to the sentence
contrast two different situations
express a consequence of the first idea
give an example
express a condition for the action
e: Whereas = enquanto (que), ao passo que.
x: Errada: adição seria moreover ou also.
Errada: condição seria if ou unless.

t: Logs must not contain sensitive personal data such as passwords, full card numbers or national identification numbers. When necessary, such data should be masked.
q: According to the text, sensitive data in logs should be:
o: stored in plain text to support future audits.
masked when necessary, never fully recorded.
shared with all developers for debugging purposes.
encrypted with the user's own password.
deleted from the database after logging.
e: “Must not contain” = não devem conter; “masked” = mascarados.
x: Errada: o texto proíbe dados sensíveis nos logs.
Errada: o texto não autoriza esse compartilhamento.
Errada: o texto fala em mascarar, não em criptografar com a senha.
Errada: o texto trata dos logs, não de excluir dados do banco.

t: The configuration file was misconfigured, which caused the service to become unreachable.
q: The prefix “mis-” in “misconfigured” and the suffix “-able” in “unreachable” indicate, respectively:
o: again (repetition), and past action
wrongly, and possibility (with un- adding negation)
before, and after
lack of, and full of
against, and the agent of the action
e: Misconfigured = configurado incorretamente; unreachable = inalcançável (não pode ser alcançado).
x: Errada: repetição seria re-; -able não indica passado.
